\documentclass[border=4pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usetikzlibrary{arrows}

% Exercises PGF's ordinary elliptical polar point inside a declared arrow.
\makeatletter
\pgfarrowsdeclare{polar thrust}{polar thrust}
{
  \pgfutil@tempdima=.5pt
  \advance\pgfutil@tempdima by.25\pgflinewidth
  \pgfarrowsleftextend{-6\pgfutil@tempdima}
  \pgfarrowsrightextend{\pgfutil@tempdima}
}
{
  \pgfutil@tempdima=.5pt
  \advance\pgfutil@tempdima by.25\pgflinewidth
  \pgfsetmiterjoin
  \pgfpathmoveto{\pgfpointpolar{145}{7\pgfutil@tempdima and 5\pgfutil@tempdima}}
  \pgfpathlineto{\pgfqpoint{\pgfutil@tempdima}{0pt}}
  \pgfpathlineto{\pgfpointpolar{-145}{7\pgfutil@tempdima and 5\pgfutil@tempdima}}
  \pgfpathclose
  \pgfusepathqfillstroke
}
\makeatother

\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
  \draw[gray!35] (-3.2,0) -- (3.2,0);
  \draw[gray!35] (0,-2.3) -- (0,2.5);
  \fill (0,0) circle (2pt) node[below right] {$O$};

  \draw[blue,line width=.4pt,-{polar thrust}] (0,0) -- (2.65,1.35) node[above right] {$\vec F_1$};
  \draw[red,line width=1pt,-{polar thrust}] (0,0) -- (-2.45,1.55) node[above left] {$\vec F_2$};
  \draw[green!50!black,line width=1.6pt,-{polar thrust}] (0,0) -- (0,-2.05) node[below] {$m\vec g$};
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
